probe_history: The first run of this probe stopped on an executor bug (a tuple was passed where a body was expected) after the cancel and fail flows had already run; the second run is the one recorded here. Both runs created tasks in the isolated test project, which is left with that litter.

reading.cancel: main asked and the worker acknowledged: the task moved cancel_requested -> cancelled, so the two-step cancel is a real handshake and not a single command
reading.fail: the worker stopped its own attempt and the task ended failed
reading.stale_owner: after submitting, the same worker could no longer act on that attempt: block answered 400 attempt_not_running and progress answered 403 capability_denied, so the authorization that came with the attempt ended with it
